beats.say: Arkane Lyon faces closure by November if no buyer steps in.
Eurogamer reports the Dishonored studio must find a new owner by 13th November.
Without a deal, 217 workers could lose their jobs as Xbox resets its studios.
The studio behind your favourite immersive games now faces a sudden deadline threatening its whole future.
Over two hundred developers are at risk because a November deadline stands between survival and total closure.
Arkane Lyon faces closure by November if no buyer steps in.
